title: Zone
description: Where the bar sits during gameplay. auto: osu! right of the playfield under the key counter, mania left of the stage at the judgement line, taiko under the lane. osu! bar: bottom centre, where osu! draws its own hit error meter (for players who turn that off).

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the bar right (positive) or left from its zone, for skins with another layout.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the bar down (positive) or up from its zone.

title: Scale
description: Overall size, 0.5–2.5.

title: Bar length / px
description: Length of the timing axis during gameplay, 200–960 px. 0 fits the zone.

title: Orientation
description: Gameplay only. Vertical runs early → late from top to bottom, for the left/right zones.

title: Backing
description: none: floats on the game with a faint fading scrim. scrim: a stronger soft scrim. panel: an 18-LAB graphite panel with a header.

title: Accent
description: map: tint the UR readout from the map's background colours. 18-lab: house amber. Judgement and early/late colours never change.

title: Tick lifetime / s
description: How long each hit tick stays on the bar while it fades, 0.25–30 s.

title: Scale range
description: judgement windows: the bar spans every timing window of the map (rate-aware). great window: zooms to ±1.5 × the 300/GREAT window; hits beyond pin to the ends.

title: Show unstable rate
description: Ten times the standard deviation of this attempt's hit errors.

title: Show mean offset
description: Average hit error in ms, labelled early or late.

title: Show early/late split
description: Share of hits that landed early and late, at each end of the bar.

title: Live distribution
description: Smoothed distribution of every hit this attempt above the ticks. Results always show it.

title: osu!mania release row
description: Separate row for long-note releases (vosu pressHitErrors/releaseHitErrors). auto shows it when the map has hold notes.

title: Results screen
description: Keep the attempt's final distribution, UR and mean in the free top-right of the results header. osu!stable's results screen has no timing statistics; lazer has its own.

title: Song select window preview
description: Show the selected map's rate-adjusted judgement windows in ms (osu! shows only the OD number) in the free centre column of song select.

title: Mania ColumnStart override
description: Leave 0 to read the stage position from your skin's skin.ini through vosu. Set your skin's ColumnStart (stable default 136) when vosu can't serve it (tosu, lazer built-in skins). Lazer centres the stage.

title: Mania ColumnWidth override
description: Leave 0 to read column widths from your skin. Otherwise one width for every column (default 30).

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Shown in the panel header when Backing is panel.
